title: Spicy Thai Peanut Sauce
description: Peanut butter, soy, sesame and fresh ginger blended smooth.

steps.do: Put everything in a food processor. Blend until completely smooth, stopping to scrape down the sides a few times so no peanut butter hides at the bottom, about 1 to 2 minutes.
Taste and adjust: more hot sauce for heat, a squeeze of lime to brighten, or a splash of water if it's thicker than you want.

notes: Use tamari to make it gluten-free; check the hoisin too, since many brands contain wheat.
"Oriental sesame oil" in older recipes means the dark, toasted kind, not plain cold-pressed sesame oil.
The sauce firms up in the fridge. Loosen with warm water, a spoonful at a time.
Keeps about 1 week refrigerated in a sealed jar.
Good with satay, cold noodles, spring rolls, or thinned as a slaw dressing.
